lsj_gloss: maternal uncle; relation by the mother's side
mother's brother or sister, uncle or aunt
note: Either sex, but always the mother's side

lsj_gloss: husband's sister or brother's wife, sister-in-law
note: Epic headword; Attic γάλως. Only 'wife's sister' (خواهرزن) is excluded

lsj_gloss: wives of brothers or of husbands' brothers, sisters-in-law
note: Plural; Persian جاری is the exact equivalent
Lexicographers only (Hesychius, Eustathius): the model may simply not know it
Generic نوه = side lost (but نوه is also the everyday Persian word)
LSJ does not restrict it to the husband's father; in Homer it is (Priam to Helen)
